description: This file contains definitions for StreamLifecycleTestGrain and supporting classes for testing stream lifecycle behavior in Orleans, including state management, observer implementations, and grain activation/deactivation logic.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleTestGrainState
classes.description: Serialiable state class for stream lifecycle test grain, stores stream info, subscription handles, and statistics.

classes.name: GenericArg
classes.description: Base class for stream-related argument classes, encapsulates common properties.

classes.name: AsyncObserverArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, used for passing stream observer arguments.

classes.name: AsyncObservableArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, used for observable arguments.

classes.name: AsyncStreamArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, used for stream arguments.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandleArg
classes.description: Derived from GenericArg, used for subscription handle arguments.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleTestGrainBase
classes.description: Base class providing common stream initialization, activation, deactivation, and logging functionalities.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleConsumerGrain
classes.description: Grain representing a stream consumer that can become a consumer, reconnect, and handle stream subscriptions.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleProducerGrain
classes.description: Grain representing a stream producer that can send items, become a producer, and handle deactivation.

classes.name: MyStreamObserver
classes.description: Implementation of IAsyncObserver to handle stream messages, errors, and completion.

classes.name: ClosedTypeStreamObserver
classes.description: Specialized observer for closed type streams.

classes.name: IClosedTypeAsyncObservable
classes.description: Interface representing a closed type async observable stream.

classes.name: IClosedTypeAsyncStream
classes.description: Interface representing a closed type async stream.

classes.name: ClosedTypeStreamSubscriptionHandle
classes.description: Handle class for closed type stream subscriptions.

methods.name: RecordActivate
methods.description: Records activation call, potentially for tracking.

methods.name: RecordDeactivate
methods.description: Records deactivation call, potentially for tracking.

methods.name: InitStream
methods.description: Initializes or resets the stream with a specified stream ID and provider.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, restoring stream state.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Transform this grain into a stream consumer and subscribe to stream.

methods.name: TestBecomeConsumerSlim
methods.description: Sets up a slim consumer extension for the stream.

methods.name: ClearGrain
methods.description: Clears stream subscriptions and resets grain state.

methods.name: SendItem
methods.description: Sends an item to the stream as a producer.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Transform this grain into a stream producer and initiate stream.

methods.name: DoDeactivateNoClose
methods.description: Deactivate the grain without closing the stream.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles stream item reception, updating counters.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream error notification, updating error count.
